subject: VM evidence: scan cadence and CVE SLA attestation
messages:
From: Acme Bank Security <security@acmebank.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Request: VM evidence (scan cadence + CVE SLAs)

Hi Jonas,

Quick ask from our vendor-risk queue: Can Redwood provide a concise evidence packet for our SOC2/SIG review covering vulnerability management? Specifically we need:

- A short statement of scan cadence (asset/network/containers) and scan tool(s) in use.
- Documented SLA commitments for CVE remediation by severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).
- Recent scan export (last full network scan + last weekly delta).
- A signed CVE remediation attestation for outstanding critical/high items and an expected closure timeline.

If possible, please include a one-page summary we can put in the SIG appendix. Ideally we get this by COB Thursday (2026-10-08). If you need a template we can provide one.

Thanks,
Mike Turner
Senior Security Analyst
Acme Bank – Third Party Risk

Attachments: none
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Acme Bank Security <security@acmebank.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence (scan cadence + CVE SLAs)

Hi Mike — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you asked for. High level answers up front, followed by what we'll attach and next steps: 

Summary (for SIG appendix):
- Scan cadence: weekly incremental network/host scans; full asset discovery and authenticated host scan monthly; container SCA (image) scanning on push + daily registry sweep.
- Tools: Nessus (network/hosts), Trivy (container images), Dependabot/Snyk for dependency scanning.
- CVE SLA commitments (Redwood Inference): Critical: 14 days; High: 30 days; Medium: 90 days; Low: triaged and scheduled (no SLA).

Planned attachments in this packet:
- weekly-scan-summary-20261004.csv (last incremental)
- patch-manifest-20261005.csv (who/what was patched in last window)
- cve-closure-attestation-jonas-20261006.pdf (signed attestation for current critical/high items)

Next steps:
1) Naomi will provide the signed attestation and the one-page summary template.
2) We will upload the packet to the Drive link below and share DocuSign if you need an executed PDF.
3) If you need additional logs (sanitized scan results) please state the exact fields to redact and we can produce a temporary, time-limited link.

Timeline: aiming to deliver the Drive packet + attestation by 2026-10-07 EOD.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: drive link (will upload), planned attestation PDF
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, Acme Bank Security <security@acmebank.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence (scan cadence + CVE SLAs)

Jonas / Mike — attaching the attestation and a brief one-pager. Short notes below: 

- Operational detail: weekly scans run every Tuesday at 03:00 UTC; full authenticated scans run first Sunday of each month at 01:00 UTC. Container registry sweep runs daily at 04:30 UTC; image pushes trigger Trivy scans on CI.
- Remediation workflow: Critical CVEs trigger an immediate incident ticket and are triaged by on-call infra within 24 hours; patch/workaround comms and rollback plans within 72 hours; remote remediation window target is 14 days. High are tracked and scheduled within 30 days; Medium/Low follow the 90-day backlog cadence.
- Evidence we are sharing: incremental scan CSV (redacted IPs -> asset aliases), patch manifest, and the signed attestation. We are not including raw vulnerable package lists in the public packet for privacy of customer subsets — we can share sanitized versions under an NDA or time-limited secure link.

Attached: cve-closure-attestation-jonas-20261006.pdf (signed), weekly-scan-summary-20261004.csv, patch-manifest-20261005.csv, redwood-vm-onepager-20261006.pdf

Naomi Feldman
Security Manager, Vulnerability Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cve-closure-attestation-jonas-20261006.pdf (application/pdf), weekly-scan-summary-20261004.csv (text/csv), patch-manifest-20261005.csv (text/csv), redwood-vm-onepager-20261006.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Mike Turner <mike.turner@acmebank.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence (scan cadence + CVE SLAs)

Thanks Naomi & Jonas — that looks good and addresses the requirements. A few quick clarifications: 

- Can you confirm whether the 14-day commitment for Critical is from detection or from vendor-released patch availability?
- For the one-pager we prefer an explicit statement signed by an officer (email confirmation is OK; DocuSign preferred for our records).
- We will accept sanitized scan CSVs if they include asset alias, severity, CVE id, and status columns (no customer-identifying data).

If those are OK we can move this to our SIG review and won't require a separate questionnaire route. DocuSign would be ideal for the attestation.

Regards,
Mike

Mike — thanks for the quick read. Clarifications: 

- The 14-day window for Critical is measured from confirmed detection/triage inside our environment. If a vendor patch is delayed beyond that window we commit to mitigations (WAF rules, configuration change, isolation) and a documented rollback plan within the 14-day target. We will annotate each attestation with the detection timestamp and remediation milestones.
- Naomi has prepared the DocuSign attestation and I have countersigned. You should see a DocuSign link in the packet (posted to Drive and the link is included below). If you prefer the signed PDF emailed back instead, say the word and we will attach the executed copy.
- We will produce the sanitized CSV export with the columns you requested and place it in the Drive folder with restricted access (time-limited link).

Deliverables (shared to Drive & DocuSign):
- cve-closure-attestation-jonas-20261006.pdf (executed via DocuSign)
- weekly-scan-summary-20261004.csv (sanitized columns: asset_alias, severity, cve_id, status)
- patch-manifest-20261005.csv
- redwood-vm-onepager-20261006.pdf

Please confirm receipt; we will mark this closed on our side once you confirm the packet meets the SIG requirements.
